title: Expression of the P53 Protein and Morphological Changes in Neurons in the Pyramidal Layer of the Hippocampus After Simulation of Surgical Interventions in the Nasal Cavity in Rats.
authors: Kastyro, Igor Vladimirovich; Mikhalskaia, Polina Vasilievna; Khamidulin, Georgy Valerievich; Kostyaeva, Margarita Guryevna; Tsymbal, Alexander Alexandrovich; Shilin, Stepan Sergeyevich; Popadyuk, Valentin Ivanovich; Pavluk-Pavluchenko, Leonid Leonidovich; Minasyan, Paruyr Nairievich; Markushin, Alexander Alexandrovich; Ganshin, Igor Borisovich
journal: Cellular physiology and biochemistry : international journal of experimental cellular physiology, biochemistry, and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过模拟鼻腔手术观察大鼠海马神经元中p53蛋白表达和暗神经元形态变化，属于纯组织学与免疫组化实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND/AIMS: To determine the role of surgical stress on the formation of p53-positive and dark neurons (DN) in the hippocampus, and to examine the parallelism of their formation in the pyramidal layer of the hippocampus. METHODS: Simulated septoplasty was performed on 20 Wistar rats. The hippocampus and dentate gyrus (DG) were examined, in which the number of DN and p53-positive neurons was determined at 2, 4 and 6 days after surgery. In each rat, 10 brain slices were stained with antibodies to p53 protein with Meyer's haematoxylin and 10 slices were stained with Nissl toluidine blue. Hippocampal subfields CA1, CA2, CA3 and DG were studied. In the pyramidal subfield layer, the absolute number of neurons that were nuclear antibody-positive to p53 protein was counted, as well as the number of dark neurons. The counting area in each subfield was 20934+/-1260 microm2. Neurons are counted using the Aperio ImageScope program. For the histological specimen analysis, the ImageJ software was used. The data obtained using cell counting methods were presented as mean +/- SE. Then, they were compared between both groups using a t-test SPSS 21software. RESULTS: Compared with the control group (n = 5), the number of DN and p53-positive neurons increased in experimental animals at all periods. A direct relationship was obtained between the increase in the number of DN and p53-positive neurons in the hippocampal formation. Septoplasty simulation in rats results in the pathogenetic cascades onset, which, in its turn, changes the morpho-functional properties of neurons of the pyramidal layer of the hippocampus and contributes to their neuroplasticity. Activation of NMDS receptors of neurons during stress apparently, initiates two ways of neuron life - the beginning of p53 protein expression and the DN formation. Both ways can finally lead to apoptosis. CONCLUSION: The formation of dark neurons and the expression of the p53 protein in them are most likely to be interconnected and can probably provide neuroprotective mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：确定手术应激在海马中p53阳性神经元和暗神经元（DN）形成中的作用，并检查它们在海马锥体层中形成的平行性。方法：对20只Wistar大鼠进行模拟鼻中隔成形术。检查海马和齿状回（DG），并在术后2、4和6天确定DN和p53阳性神经元的数量。每只大鼠中，10张脑切片用p53蛋白抗体和迈耶氏苏木精染色，10张切片用尼氏甲苯胺蓝染色。研究海马亚区CA1、CA2、CA3和DG。在锥体亚层中，计数对p53蛋白核抗体阳性的神经元绝对数量，以及暗神经元的数量。每个亚区的计数面积为20934±1260微米²。使用Aperio ImageScope程序计数神经元。组织学标本分析使用ImageJ软件。通过细胞计数方法获得的数据以平均值±标准误表示。然后，使用t检验SPSS 21软件在两组之间进行比较。结果：与对照组（n=5）相比，实验动物在所有时间点的DN和p53阳性神经元数量均增加。海马结构中DN和p53阳性神经元数量的增加之间存在直接关系。大鼠中的鼻中隔成形术模拟导致致病级联反应启动，这反过来改变了海马锥体层神经元的形态功能特性，并促进其神经可塑性。应激期间神经元NMDS受体的激活，显然启动了神经元生命的两种途径——p53蛋白表达的开始和DN的形成。两种途径最终都可能导致细胞凋亡。结论：暗神经元的形成及其中的p53蛋白表达最有可能相互关联，并可能提供神经保护机制。
